gates.name: Composite checkpoint completeness
gates.requirement: Schema 2 represents every accepted NonlinearState component, topology and digest.
gates.negative_case: Missing contact or metadata field is rejected.

gates.name: Round-trip exactness
gates.requirement: Save then load reproduces every component digest and the composite digest.

gates.name: Fixed-load restart equivalence
gates.requirement: Continuous and interrupted/restarted fixed/adaptive load-control runs agree in final state and bounded diagnostics.

gates.name: Arc-length restart equivalence
gates.requirement: Continuous and interrupted/restarted arc-length paths agree in displacement, load factor, radius and continuation state.
gates.threshold: Physical restart threshold plus exact persisted state digests.

gates.name: Checkpoint integrity
gates.requirement: Corrupt, non-finite and digest-mismatched checkpoints fail deterministically with the frozen error distinction.

gates.name: Atomic persistence
gates.requirement: A failed write cannot expose a partially valid canonical checkpoint.
gates.negative_case: Target remains prior valid checkpoint or is absent; never truncated canonical output.

gates.name: v1 compatibility
gates.requirement: Supported v1 checkpoints migrate safely to v2, while ambiguous contact-bearing v1 inputs follow OD-029-02.
gates.threshold: No undocumented compatibility break or false historical claim.

gates.name: One state authority
gates.requirement: Legacy helpers do not create a second accepted-state or digest authority.
gates.negative_case: No legacy commit can publish a persisted nonlinear state independently.

gates.name: No trial persistence
gates.requirement: Rejected/unaccepted trial data never enters a checkpoint.
gates.negative_case: Injected failed trial is absent after reload.

gates.name: Numerical preservation
gates.requirement: Existing nonlinear fixed/adaptive/arc behavior remains unchanged outside persistence plumbing.
gates.threshold: Existing frozen regression thresholds; no tolerance relaxation.

award_policy: WP02-A freezes these gates and awards 0/6. Points require implementation evidence and independent closure review.
